name: Sheraton Hanoi West
short_description: Sheraton's second Hanoi hotel, a modern 520-key business and events property in the Nam Tu Liem district beside My Dinh National Stadium, with a 24th-floor Club Lounge, rooftop Sky Bar, spa and pool.
ai_summary: Sheraton Hanoi West opened in May 2024 as Marriott's second Sheraton in the Vietnamese capital, occupying a reflagged 25-storey tower in the western Nam Tu Liem district that previously operated as the Hyatt Regency (and earlier Crowne Plaza) West Hanoi. The 520-key property combines 390 guest rooms and suites with 130 serviced residences, making it a natural fit for business travelers, convention delegates and long-stay guests rather than first-time tourists. Independent coverage and guest feedback consistently single out the service: staff are described as warm, attentive and genuinely welcoming, and the 24th-floor Club Lounge draws particular praise for its food, evening cocktails and helpful team. Rooms are generally called spacious, clean and modern, with floor-to-ceiling windows, comfortable beds and well-equipped bathrooms, while the breakfast buffet spans Vietnamese pho and Asian and Western dishes. Facilities are extensive for the neighborhood, including an outdoor freeform pool, full-service spa, 24-hour fitness center, all-day dining at The Market, a rooftop Sky Bar overlooking My Dinh National Stadium, and 661 square meters of event space anchored by a 418-square-meter ballroom. The main trade-off is location: the hotel sits roughly 11 km west of the Old Quarter and Hoan Kiem Lake, so sightseers face a 20-to-30-minute drive and find little within walking distance beyond the stadium and convention center. As a recently converted property, a few guests note occasional finishes or service moments that fall short of true five-star polish. On balance it is a strong, comfortable choice for anyone with business in west Hanoi or attending events at the nearby stadium and convention center.

faqs.question: How far is Sheraton Hanoi West from Noi Bai International Airport?
faqs.answer: The hotel sits about 27 km from Noi Bai International Airport, roughly a 30-minute drive depending on traffic. It is located in west Hanoi's Nam Tu Liem district, right by My Dinh National Stadium and around eight minutes from the National Convention Center.

faqs.question: Is Sheraton Hanoi West a good base for sightseeing in central Hanoi?
faqs.answer: Not especially. The hotel lies roughly 11 km west of the Old Quarter and Hoan Kiem Lake, about a 20 to 30 minute drive. It suits business travelers, convention delegates and stadium-event guests who prefer a quieter, modern setting over proximity to the main tourist attractions.

faqs.question: What dining and leisure facilities does Sheraton Hanoi West offer?
faqs.answer: Dining includes all-day dining at The Market, a Lobby Lounge and the rooftop Sky Bar overlooking the stadium. Leisure facilities cover an outdoor freeform pool, a full-service spa, a 24-hour fitness center and a 24th-floor Club Lounge for eligible Marriott Bonvoy elites and club guests.
